instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the brand identity: Dark Tech & High Precision. Primary color is vivid orange (#F26522) with deep navy/slate backgrounds (#070D18, #0F172A).
Ensure header automatically displays the correct brand logo asset depending on light or dark theme mode.
Implement full German localization tailored for Telfs, Innsbruck & Tirol region.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select items, builder cards, tabs, modal triggers) include explicit data-testid attributes.
Provide responsive layouts optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop with explicit focus styles and keyboard navigation support.
Ensure background of sticky header uses glassmorphism with backdrop blur and semi-opaque fill so text never overlaps underlying content.
Do not wrap this design guidelines JSON in markdown code fences when generating or loading.
